ru.solution_md:

$a=\sqrt{15^2+20^2}=\sqrt{625}=25$.

Периметр: $P=4a=4\cdot 25=100$ см.

en.stem_md: The diagonals of rhombus $ABCD$ are $30$ cm and $40$ cm. Find the perimeter of the rhombus (in cm).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="101.5,110 160,32 218.5,110 160,188" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="101.5" y1="110" x2="218.5" y2="110" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="160" y1="32" x2="160" y2="188" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="171,110 171,99 160,99" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><text x="86.5" y="110" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="160" y="17" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="233.5" y="110" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text><text x="160" y="203" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">D</text><text x="133.1" y="97" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">30</text><text x="173" y="74.1" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">40</text></svg>

$a=\sqrt{15^2+20^2}=\sqrt{625}=25$.

Perimeter: $P=4a=4\cdot 25=100$ cm.
en.mistake_note_md: Using the full diagonals instead of their halves in the Pythagorean theorem, or forgetting to multiply the side by $4$.

kaa.solution_md:

Perimetr: $P=4a=4\cdot 25=100$ sm.

en.stem_md: The diagonals of rhombus $ABCD$ are $14$ cm and $48$ cm. Find the perimeter of the rhombus (in cm).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="137.3,110 160,32 182.8,110 160,188" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="137.3" y1="110" x2="182.8" y2="110" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="160" y1="32" x2="160" y2="188" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="171,110 171,99 160,99" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><text x="122.3" y="110" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="160" y="17" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="197.8" y="110" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text><text x="160" y="203" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">D</text><text x="149.5" y="97" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">14</text><text x="173" y="74.1" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">48</text></svg>

$a=\sqrt{7^2+24^2}=\sqrt{625}=25$.

Perimeter: $P=4a=4\cdot 25=100$ cm.
en.mistake_note_md: Using the full diagonals instead of their halves in the Pythagorean theorem, or forgetting to multiply the side by $4$.

$a=\sqrt{5^2+12^2}=\sqrt{169}=13$.

Perimeter: $P=4a=4\cdot 13=52$ cm.

ru.solution_md:

$a=\sqrt{15^2+8^2}=\sqrt{289}=17$.

Периметр: $P=4a=4\cdot 17=68$ см.

en.stem_md: The diagonals of rhombus $ABCD$ are $30$ cm and $16$ cm. Find the perimeter of the rhombus (in cm).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="32,110 160,41.7 288,110 160,178.3" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="32" y1="110" x2="288" y2="110" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="160" y1="41.7" x2="160" y2="178.3" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="171,110 171,99 160,99" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><text x="17" y="110" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="160" y="26.7" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="303" y="110" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text><text x="160" y="193.3" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">D</text><text x="101.1" y="97" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">30</text><text x="173" y="78.6" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">16</text></svg>

en.solution_md:
The diagonals of a rhombus are perpendicular and bisect each other. So the side of the rhombus is the hypotenuse of a right triangle with legs $15$ and $8$.

$a=\sqrt{15^2+8^2}=\sqrt{289}=17$.

Perimeter: $P=4a=4\cdot 17=68$ cm.
en.mistake_note_md: Using the full diagonals instead of their halves in the Pythagorean theorem, or forgetting to multiply the side by $4$.

kaa.solution_md:
Romb diagonalları óz ara perpendikulyar hám kesilisiw noqatında teń ekige bólinedi. Sonıń ushın romb tárepi katetleri $6$ hám $8$ bolǵan tuwrımúyeshli úshmúyeshliktiń gipotenuzası boladı.

$a=\sqrt{6^2+8^2}=\sqrt{100}=10$.

Perimetr: $P=4a=4\cdot 10=40$ sm.

en.solution_md:
The diagonals of a rhombus are perpendicular and bisect each other. So the side of the rhombus is the hypotenuse of a right triangle with legs $6$ and $8$.

$a=\sqrt{6^2+8^2}=\sqrt{100}=10$.

Perimeter: $P=4a=4\cdot 10=40$ cm.
en.mistake_note_md: Using the full diagonals instead of their halves in the Pythagorean theorem, or forgetting to multiply the side by $4$.

kaa.solution_md: Diagonallar óz ara perpendikulyar hám kesilisiw noqatında teń bólinedi: Pifagor teoreması. $\sqrt{21^{2}+72^{2}}=75$ Juwap: $75$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Diagonallardı (yarımı ornına) tárepler menen shatastırıw yamasa romb maydanın $d_{1}d_{2}$ dep alıw.

en.stem_md: The diagonals of a rhombus are $42$ and $144$. Find the side of the rhombus.
en.solution_md: The diagonals are perpendicular and bisect each other: use the Pythagorean theorem. $\sqrt{21^{2}+72^{2}}=75$ Answer: $75$.
en.mistake_note_md: Using a whole diagonal (not half) as a leg, or the rhombus area as $d_{1}d_{2}$.

questions.stem_md: Parallelogrammning qo'shni tomonlari $12$ va $14$, ular orasidagi burchak $30^\circ$. Parallelogramm yuzini toping.
questions.solution_md: $S=ab\sin\alpha=12\cdot 14\cdot \frac{1}{2}=84$ Javob: $84$.
questions.mistake_note_md: $\sin 30^\circ=\frac{1}{2}$ ni hisobga olmay $ab$ ni yuz deb olish.

ru.stem_md: Смежные стороны параллелограмма равны $12$ и $14$, угол между ними $30^\circ$. Найдите площадь параллелограмма.
ru.solution_md: $S=ab\sin\alpha=12\cdot 14\cdot \frac{1}{2}=84$ Ответ: $84$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Берут $ab$ за площадь, не учитывая $\sin 30^\circ=\frac{1}{2}$.

kaa.stem_md: Parallelogrammnıń qońsı tárepleri $12$ hám $14$, olar arasındaǵı múyesh $30^\circ$. Parallelogramm maydanın tabıń.
kaa.solution_md: $S=ab\sin\alpha=12\cdot 14\cdot \frac{1}{2}=84$ Juwap: $84$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: $\sin 30^\circ=\frac{1}{2}$ di esapqa almay $ab$ nı maydan dep alıw.

en.stem_md: Adjacent sides of a parallelogram are $12$ and $14$ with an angle of $30^\circ$ between them. Find its area.
en.solution_md: $S=ab\sin\alpha=12\cdot 14\cdot \frac{1}{2}=84$ Answer: $84$.
en.mistake_note_md: Taking $ab$ as the area without the factor $\sin 30^\circ=\frac{1}{2}$.
